display.purpose: The single H1: Mona Sans 800 at 75% width.

title.purpose: Sub-headings, step titles, FAQ questions, statement lines.

label.purpose: Buttons, captions, table labels. Sentence case.

shadows.name: odometer-fade
shadows.value: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg), transparent 26%, transparent 74%, var(--bg)) at 70% opacity
shadows.purpose: Inner fade on odometer cells so the digits read as a rolling wheel. The only depth effect in the system.

motion.name: dur-ui
motion.purpose: Menu panel, menu icon cross-fade, FAQ answer, form messages, hover fills.

motion.name: odometer
motion.purpose: Authored moment: stats roll into place on scroll-in.

motion.name: hero-opening
motion.value: letterbox 1.3s ease-in-out; push 2.8s ease-out; words .95s ease-out from .75s, 90ms apart; copy .8s from 1.25s
motion.purpose: Authored moment: the hero opens like a film, once, on load.

motion.name: hero-video
motion.value: fade in 1.4s ease-out at 2.4s, desktop only
motion.purpose: Muted graded loop behind the hero; pauses off screen; visible pause button.

components.name: Call Button
components.description: The one coloured element: call the shop.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 1px; background: #6FA383; color: #141517; font: 700 15px/1.2 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 92%; letter-spacing: .01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: #5E9273; } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3F0; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-solid:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Line Button on Graphite
components.description: Secondary action (Get a Quote) beside the Call button, outside the first viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 1px; border: 1px solid #F4F3F0; color: #F4F3F0; background: #1B1C1E; font: 700 15px/1.2 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: #F4F3F0; color: #1B1C1E; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3F0; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-line:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Field on Graphite
components.description: Quote form field with its label and inline error.
components.css: .ds-field { padding: 16px; background: #1B1C1E; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font: 700 14px 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #F4F3F0; } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #F4F3F0; background: #26272A; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3F0; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field em { font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; color: #FF9F8E; }

narrative.overview: A family repair shop presented with the calm of a high-end service house, but built from the materials of a real workshop: graphite and concrete grounds, condensed lettering like the labels on a tool case or the headings in a service manual, and photographs of hands at work. Trust comes from restraint and specifics; customers' own words carry the argument. Bands alternate graphite and concrete. Every photo carries the same muted colour grade. The interface has exactly one colour, machine green, and it only appears on the Call action. Motion has two authored moments, the hero opening and the odometer; on desktop a muted graded video loop fades in behind the hero with a visible pause button.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite and concrete bands, steel greys, one machine-green accent for Call only.
Mona Sans throughout: condensed and heavy for headings, near normal width for reading.
Muted colour photography (about 60% saturation, slightly warm), square-edged, never under text.
A cinematic 2.39:1 hero with static film grain and a soft vignette.
Hairline rules (1px) are the only structure: no cards, no boxes, no shadows on content.

rules.name: The One Working Colour Rule
rules.body: Machine green means "call the shop" and nothing else. If it appears anywhere that isn't a Call action, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Bands alternate graphite and concrete, never two of the same tone side by side, except the quote band and the footer, which a hairline separates. Components read their colours from the band.

rules.name: The Shop Lettering Rule
rules.body: Headings are condensed and heavy; reading text is not. Never set paragraphs or quotes below 92% width.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is 1px rules. No cards, no boxed panels, no drop shadows.

dos: Do give every photograph the same muted colour grade (saturation 0.6, a slight warm cast, linear 1.05 / -6) and each screen one decisive frame.
Do alternate graphite and concrete bands, and let components read their colours from the band.
Do set headings condensed and heavy, and reading text near normal width.
Do keep the Call button inside the first screen.
donts: Don't use machine green for anything but Call actions.
Don't put text over a photograph.
Don't box content into cards or add drop shadows; use hairline rules.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings or uppercase labels (the wordmark is the only uppercase).
Don't add scroll-triggered fade-ins to sections; the hero opening and the odometer are the only authored moments.
Don't autoplay any other media, and never ship the hero video without its pause button.
